Oil firms to roll back diesel prices by P23, gasoline by P6.50 on Tuesday | ANC

After several consecutive weeks of increases, fuel prices are expected to decline this week with local oil companies set to implement significant rollbacks across diesel, gasoline, and kerosene products, according to industry projections released on Monday (April 13).

Overwatch 2 Is Gone…Now It’s Back To Overwatch

Overwatch is back.

According to Blizzard, the big reason for removing the number from the name is because "Overwatch is more than just a digit" but we all know that the promises from Overwatch 2 of a robust Player vs. Environment (PvE) mode, featuring a full campaign, hero-specific skill trees, and highly replayable Hero Missions never actually fulfilled so it's good to see the branding change sage.
